**Top Perforating Gun Manufacturers & Suppliers** 

- **Oso Perforating:** Manufactures American-made, high-quality systems like the Colt 45 and Colt 45 Trigger systems.
- **[DynaEnergetics](https://www.google.com/search?q=DynaEnergetics&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwi36Y76lZGUAxXUNoYAHeEIMZIQgK4QegYIAQgAEBA) (DMC Global):** Offers a wide range of in-house designed perforating systems, including strip and exposed gun systems.
- **Yellow Jacket Oil Tools:** Known for its ZERO™ Self-Orienting Gun System and patented technologies for safer transportation.
- **[Repeat Precision](https://www.google.com/search?q=Repeat+Precision&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwi36Y76lZGUAxXUNoYAHeEIMZIQgK4QegYIAQgCEAE):** Manufactures the PurpleFire™ line of disposable, ready-to-run wireline perforating guns.
- **GEODynamics:** Specializes in engineered, high-performance perforating solutions like the EPIC™ flex, perf, and plug systems.
- **[SWM Technologies](https://www.google.com/search?q=SWM+Technologies&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwi36Y76lZGUAxXUNoYAHeEIMZIQgK4QegYIAQgCEAQ):** Produces high-performance gun systems with a focus on, and support for, custom applications.

- **[Baker Hughes](https://www.google.com/search?q=Baker+Hughes&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwi36Y76lZGUAxXUNoYAHeEIMZIQgK4QegYIAQgBEAc):** Produces customized, high-performance systems for varied well completion needs.
